title: Spectral erase
name: Spectral erase, before
description: A warm pad with a whistle on top, about 2.6 kHz.

title: Spectral erase
name: Spectral erase, after

title: Warp

title: Warp
name: Warp, after
description: The same loop slowed to 96 bpm with the pitch kept. Warp mode Beats keeps the drum hits sharp.

title: Pitch fix
name: Pitch fix, before
description: A short synth melody 40 cents flat.

title: Pitch fix
name: Pitch fix, after
description: The same melody moved up 0.4 semitone: now in tune.

title: Cut and fade
name: Cut and fade, before
description: A take with a click at the start, a pause, a short tone phrase and a long silence after it.

title: Cut and fade
name: Cut and fade, after
description: The click silenced, the silence trimmed away, a fade out and the level normalized.
